text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Biwa Hayahide and I<n>head to the
training course to apply<n>the data she's collected
today into<n>her calculations.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At the track, we find Winning Ticket<n>and Narita
Taishin training, apparently<n>having been inspired by
the race to<n>work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Watching them run their hearts out<n>makes Biwa
Hayahide realize it's<n>only a matter of time before
she must<n>face them at the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
More importantly though, she must<n>set herself
apart to compete against<n>her sister. And to achieve
that, we<n>make our next goal the first race in<n>the
Classic Triple Crown tour, the<n>Satsuki Sho.
